metadata.name: New York AIR NY Aviation Capital Grant
metadata.agency: New York State Department of Transportation (NYSDOT), Aviation Bureau
metadata.source_citation: NYSDOT Aviation 2024 Notice of Funding Availability/Grant Program Guidelines (AIR NY: Airport Investment and Revitalization for New York). Source: https://www.dot.ny.gov/divisions/operating/opdm/aviation/repository/2024%20NOFA-Guidelines%20Final.pdf

decisions_log.author: APH m49 Sprint 8 reference encoder
decisions_log.decision: Encoded New York with eligibility_gate (pass/fail screening) + two-tier scoring (project specific + airport specific) + secondary selection criteria.
decisions_log.rationale: NYSDOT NOFA explicitly describes pass/fail eligibility screening, then two-category scoring (project-specific + airport-specific), plus a secondary criteria layer covering project type, eligible funding source, significance, cost-effectiveness, geographic balance, and GHG/Environmental Justice benefits.

criteria.label: Project-Specific Scoring
criteria.description: First major scoring category. Covers safety, economic impact, operational efficiency, and project type alignment.

criteria.label: Airport-Specific Scoring
criteria.description: Second major category. Airport role, activity, compliance, and prior investment.

criteria.label: Secondary Selection Criteria
criteria.description: Additional criteria incorporated in final selection: project type, eligible funding source, significance, cost-effectiveness, geographic balance, GHG mitigation in Environmental Justice Communities.

subcategories.label: Significance to NYS Aviation System Plan
GHG mitigation in Environmental Justice community

filters.label: Pass/fail screen — eligible applicant + project
filters.rule: Applications must meet AIR NY Eligible Applicant and Eligible Project criteria per the NOFA. Only those passing the initial screening are scored.

governance.statute_citation: AIR NY (Airport Investment and Revitalization for New York) program established under 5-year NYS Transportation Capital Program
governance.approval_process: Pass/fail eligibility screening, then scoring by project-specific + airport-specific criteria. Secondary criteria considered in final selection. Up to $25M annually under AIR NY.

disclaimer: Encoded from NYSDOT 2024 NOFA Guidelines (publicly published). The two-category structure (project-specific + airport-specific) and the 5-component secondary criteria list are documented. Specific numerical scoring weights are inferred to match the published structure. NY stakeholders should calibrate to NYSDOT internal scoring matrix before adoption.
